size_note: closed 90 x 49 x 30 mm (GSMArena; the service manual 90 x 50 x 30). Shown open: the keypad cover hangs below the body. The open length is measured on the Mobile Phone Museum's straight-on shot of the open phone (the cover lies flat: its length matches the closed shot), at 49.5 mm wide: 136.6 mm. The museum unit has lost its antenna cap; the antenna (layout_mm.parts) is measured on the press render. No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD measures about 30 x 23 mm; 1.45in at the native 96 x 72

key_icons: Oval lavender keys in four columns, each digit with its small letters to its right in italic; the fourth column reads a green handset (call), MEMO, CLR and a red handset (end). The 1 key also shows a small voicemail icon; the 0 key shows a space symbol and '+'; the # key shows '@'.
